Introduction
This document outlines the inspection checklist for Automatic Telephone 
 System type BOSCH INTEGRAL33XE which must be carried out on an annually
The first draft is 
initiated by eng. Elsayed Sobhy Saadand 
and tested by eng. Usama Ahmed, accepted by eng. Haseeb Heseen general director, approved by eng.
Mohamed AbdEl 
Paset
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
A 
 work order must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear 
 safety helmet, shoes.
Safety 
 helmet, shoes, and rags
Digital Ammeter.
Screw Driver.
Open end Spanner 
 set.
Work to be Carried Out
Steps to Prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures 
 manual.
Obtain 
 copy of Automatic Telephone System field maintenance file.
Testing Procedure
Disconnect power supply
Check and clean the electronic card as follow
Analog subscriber circuit ( ASCEU )
Analog trunk circuit ( ATA )
Digital line card ( DUPO )
Computer board ( CB )
Control module ( CFD )
Connect power supply and check the function
Make a function test of the system
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance
